name: bornochinho-codemirror
description: Builds static/vendor/codemirror.min.js, the CodeMirror 6 bundle behind the JSON editor.

scripts.build: node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=CM --target=es2020 "--banner:js=/*! CodeMirror 6 (MIT, https://codemirror.net) - built from tools/codemirror: npm ci && npm run build */" --outfile=../../static/vendor/codemirror.min.js
